assistant|refinery_yield_recommendations: To increase refinery yield: optimize process conditions, upgrade equipment, use advanced technologies, improve feedstock quality, reduce waste, and continuously monitor performance.

Six more yield levers: improve energy efficiency, enhance product quality, improve safety/reliability/maintenance operations, utilize by-product streams, invest in R&D, and collaborate with stakeholders.
